lockFileMaintenance.description: No lock file in this repo (the Dockerfile installs straight from pyproject.toml), so there is nothing to maintain.

packageRules.description: pyproject.toml dependencies. The poetry manager supersedes pep621 for this file today (the dashboard lists them under poetry); pep621 stays so the group holds if that flips. commitMessageSuffix clears the preset's [automerge] tag.
